text:
Subject: A gentle reminder regarding our meeting schedule

Hi Team,

I hope you are having a wonderful day. I wanted to share a quick thought about our upcoming client meetings. Punctuality is a key part of how we present our professionalism and respect for our partners.

I’ve noticed that there have been a few instances recently where we’ve arrived a bit later than planned. While I know life can be unpredictable, let’s try to ensure we are on time moving forward to maintain our strong reputation. Consistent lateness can impact how our company is perceived, so please do your best to plan ahead and arrive promptly.

On a lighter note, as we head into the rainy season, remember that the rain comes from fluffy things in the sky. It’s a nice reminder to stay cozy and prepared!

Thank you for your attention to this and for your continued hard work.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
